summary: Practise 3W analysis, authority liaison and coordination follow-up. Explore the five-day humanitarian aid coordination course and review the outline.
lede: Humanitarian aid coordination aligns partner activities, needs information and response decisions across agencies and communities. For humanitarian affairs officers, cluster coordinators and field coordinators, the course develops practical ways to validate 3W activity data, compare activities with assessed needs, and turn meetings into clear decisions and follow-up. You will also practise preparing coordination summaries and handover plans while accounting for participation barriers and differing reporting formats.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits practitioners who connect local authorities, response partners and communities to humanitarian coordination and response planning.
modules: IASC Cluster Coordination and Authority Links
Humanitarian Programme Cycle and Joint Assessment
prerequisites: Prior experience in humanitarian response, inter-agency coordination or partner information-sharing is recommended. No coding is required; exercises use coordination artefacts, spreadsheets and shared documents.
